text: This report recommends approval of travel expenses for two staff, Stirling Bogey, Senior Event and Meeting Coordinator and Richard Bonnick, Event and Meeting Coordinator to attend the second year and the first year respectively of the International Association of Venue Managers (IAVM), Venue Management School (VMS) in 2026.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Authorized travel expenses for Stirling Bogie, Senior Event and Meeting Coordinator, and Richard Bonnick, Event and Meeting Coordinator to attend the International Association of Venue Managers School in Palm Springs, California from June 6 to June 11, 2026, at a cost not expected to exceed $6,500 each plus HST for flights, accommodation, and incidental expenses per registrant.
